Marta: quick flag 0 accounts from last connector sync have inconsistent owner_emails (two rows, diff emails). this is causing playbook routing loops and duplicate renewal nudges.
Evan: can you share a sample query to surface them?
Marta: used: SELECT account_id, array_agg(owner_email) FROM owners GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT owner_email) > 1 LIMIT 100; returned 10.
Priya: plan: 1) pause connector backfill for 30m, 2) run idempotent merge that normalizes owner_email to canonical_primary if available, 3) tag affected accounts with 'owners:review' and suppress renewal nudges for 48h.
Evan: agree. also queue a healthscore delta job for those accounts after merge so we don't trigger false renewal-risk alerts.
Marta: Playbook snippet (dry-run):
```yaml
- name: owners-canonicalize-and-suppress
  trigger: account.has_mismatched_owner_emails == true
  actions:
    - tag: owners:review
    - route: csops-queue
    - suppress_renewal_nudges: 48h
  mode: dry_run
```
CSPlaybookBot: dry-run scheduled for rule 'owners-canonicalize-and-suppress' against last 7d at 2026-06-12T09:00Z. estimated matches: 10. report will post here.
Priya: thanks. Marta please run merge dry-run and paste results. Evan will prep healthscore recompute job.
Marta: starting dry-run now, will update in ~10m.
